meeting.summary: Northwind runs 40 regional depots on a legacy on-prem TMS. Dispatchers re-key orders by hand, there is no real-time fleet visibility, and month-end reporting takes a week. They want a unified platform before peak season in Q4.
goals: Single source of truth for orders
Live tracking for dispatchers and customers
constraints: Must integrate with existing SAP finance
meeting.budgetSignals: Indicated a six-figure budget for year one.

offer.title: A unified, real-time logistics platform — live before peak season
offer.executiveSummary:
Northwind's dispatchers lose hours every day re-keying orders and chasing trucks across 40 depots, while leadership waits a week for numbers that should be instant. That friction caps how much volume you can take on — exactly when Q4 demands more.

S3 Tech will replace the manual seams with one connected platform: orders flow in once, fleet status is live on every dispatcher's screen, and operational reporting closes same-day. We deliver it in phased releases so value lands well before peak.
objectives: Eliminate manual order re-keying across all 40 depots
Give dispatchers and customers live fleet visibility
Cut month-end reporting from 5 days to same-day
Go live ahead of Q4 peak with zero finance disruption

scope.name: Unified order intake
scope.description: A single ingestion layer that captures orders from web, EDI, and email into one validated pipeline — no re-keying.

scope.name: Real-time fleet visibility
scope.description: Live tracking surfaced to dispatchers and a customer-facing portal.

scope.name: Same-day reporting
scope.description: An operational data layer feeding dashboards and the SAP finance handoff.

milestones: Order intake live in 5 pilot depots
